large_load._note: FERC EL26-72 show-cause (ISO-NE lacks large-load provisions). Response due 2026-11-16 (a §205 filing satisfies it); nothing filed as of 2026-10-06. Every entry below is the ISO-NE / PTO-AC PROPOSAL, not tariff: S6 shows each one badged pending and re-verifies after the filing. Owner: S6 (rules/largeload.js).

filing.src: 196 FERC ¶ 61,132 PP 7-9 (recited in 196 FERC ¶ 61,215, EL26-72-001); ISO-NE Large Loads Integration key project page (R3 D2-D3)

threshold_mw.basis: gross peak load at one site, regardless of co-located generation; an expansion that takes the gross peak to the threshold counts
threshold_mw.src: ISO-NE RC/TC deck 2026-08-18/19 slides 6-9; 195 FERC ¶ 61,215 fn 2 and P 56 (R3 D4)

threshold_kv.note: ISO-NE's proposal is inclusive (69 kV or greater); FERC's preliminary definition says greater than 69 kV. The app screens on the ISO-NE proposal.
threshold_kv.src: ISO-NE RC/TC deck 2026-08-18/19 slides 6-9; 195 FERC ¶ 61,215 fn 2 (R3 D4)

rows.name: Firm Contract Demand Service
rows.text: Permanent, firm, fixed contract MW that cannot be exceeded; same curtailment priority as RNS/LNS load; every identified network upgrade must be in service first

rows.name: Non-Firm Contract Demand Service
rows.text: Permanent non-firm service, studied with the load's flexibility to minimise upgrades; billed on actual demand at the monthly peak; curtailable

rows.name: Interim Contract Demand Service
rows.text: Temporary non-firm service before the upgrades are done, billed as NFCDS; converts to FCDS when its requirements (upgrades included) are met

services.note: A large load cannot take traditional RNS/LNS, and one point of delivery cannot be split across services.
services.src: ISO-NE RC/TC deck 2026-08-18/19 slides 10-31; PTO-AC deck 2026-09-15 slides 7, 14 (R3 D5)

study_days.note: Large-load study from a complete application; rolling applications, outside the generator cluster studies. Facilities study and construction durations are not published.

cra.formula: max(0, carrying charge × Large Load Network Upgrades (excluding Similar Upgrades) − FCDS charge)
cra.carrying_charge_note: Not published. The PTO-AC deck's worked example uses an illustrative carrying charge; it is not a PTO rate and is never used.
cra.similar_upgrades: Upgrades duplicating RSP-list projects are excluded from the CRA; the RSP-list match is not held, so the study cost may include them.
cra.llif: Sole-use Large Load Interconnection Facilities are recovered separately (not in the CRA).
cra.src: PTO-AC 'Proposed Large Load Cost Recovery Agreement' 2026-09-15 slides 7-13, 16-17 (R3 D7, R3 §3.4)

rows.text: Bring your own new generation (BYONG): designated resources before FCDS; the large load is excluded from the Installed Capacity Requirement. Cost = self-supply cost; detailed rules in 2027.
Interim service may start before BYONG is met; the self-supply cost follows at conversion to FCDS.
No BYONG requirement (curtailable). FCM treatment of large loads while BYONG detail is pending is an open question.

capacity.src: ISO-NE RC/TC deck 2026-08-18/19 slides 4, 16-17; informational report 2026-07-20 (R3 D6; R3 open question 11)

local_adders.note: Local Network Service (OATT Schedule 21), Schedule 12C, distribution and retail transmission tracker, by PTO: not retrieved.

rns_rate.note: Reference only: a large load would pay FCDS/NFCDS instead of RNS under the proposal; never add both. FCDS and NFCDS/ICDS are billed at this rate (R3 D7-D9).
